hypothesis.description: Concurrent RID allocation in the dummy backend is a source-supported possibility. The dummy owner defaults to non-thread-safe allocation; GLES3 explicitly uses a thread-safe owner. This does not establish the cause of the observed error. Rendering-thread free_rid flushes pending commands before freeing, so resource release alone does not establish initialize-after-free.

sources.claim: Dummy uses default non-thread-safe RID_PtrOwner; texture_2d_initialize fails if that owner no longer contains the supplied RID. This is not the PNG-image-null check.
RID_Alloc and RID_PtrOwner THREAD_SAFE template defaults are false; allocation growth and counters lock only when true.
GLES3 texture storage explicitly uses RID_Owner<Texture,true>.

Texture creation allocates RID on caller thread before queuing initialize. Rendering-thread free_rid flushes pending commands before _free. Thus a main-thread resource clear does not alone establish initialize-after-free.
Threaded ResourceLoader calls _load before taking its load-status mutex; texture creation can run on workers.

limits: Bounded passing reruns do not rule out the intermittent error.
